objective: Build a polished, compact Godot tower-defense vertical slice where three workshop instruments create readable thermal reactions along one living fuse, culminating in a memorable furnace-warden boss.

nodes.instructions: Explore three-tower thermal-combo grammars, enemy counterplay, wave pacing, and meaningful upgrade choices for an eight-to-twelve-minute vertical slice. Preserve the one-fuse identity. Propose a bounded but surprising candidate, not a generic genre checklist.

Explore tactile placement, attack anticipation, reaction feedback, readable combat density, accessibility, onboarding, and the smallest useful audio vocabulary. Identify how the game can feel authored and juicy without hiding tactical state.

Develop contrasting wave arcs and a furnace-warden finale that force the player to reinterpret the same three instruments. Seek one memorable systemic twist that fits the existing compact Godot architecture.

Act as Design System Director. Use the installed imagegen skill and Codex built-in ImageGen tool to create exactly two controlled visual-language studies informed by STYLE.md, visual-direction.json, the pinned art target, campaign assignment, and scout findings. They are material, hierarchy, component, and motion references, never final screenshots to copy. Copy the selected PNGs into design/references/, record the exact final prompts, and never use an API-key CLI fallback. Author DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, design-system.json using apiVersion gamefactory.design-system/v1, and a valid Godot Theme at design/theme/emberline_theme.tres. Define identity, prioritized principles, extensible color/typography/spacing/shape/material/motion/audio/feedback/accessibility tokens, reusable patterns, SHA-256-pinned references, and SHA-256-pinned implementations. Every ImageGen reference uses source imagegen and includes its prompt. Do not implement gameplay. Preserve creative latitude through semantic roles rather than frozen layouts. Return structured JSON with complete outcome and all artifacts.

Inspect the authored design system, both ImageGen studies, pinned target, and baseline captures with image-aware tools. Translate them into a bounded art hierarchy for this Godot build. Diagnose material separation, lighting, composition, enemy/tower readability, typography, prop craft, and motion. Preserve the system without literally copying reference layouts. Return ready with prioritized findings and an implementation brief.

Synthesize one opinionated candidate-specific vertical slice: combat grammar, teaching sequence, four-wave arc, boss twist, interaction contract, visual hierarchy, deterministic evidence, and bounded implementation plan. Preserve player agency and creative conviction instead of averaging scout ideas.

Implement a complete polished playable vertical slice within mutable paths. Keep title, build, four-wave, boss, victory/defeat/replay flows. Make placement, heat reactions, enemy intent, economy, and upgrades legible and satisfying. Visual polish is product work: implement the design system with authored material layers, depth, lighting, typography, props, particles, recoil and motion. Use code-native Godot rendering and project assets appropriately. Run import/headless checks and preserve honest deterministic factory hooks whose score derives from observed simulation. Prefer a cohesive finished slice over unused framework.
Capture deterministic title, board, and live wave evidence from the running Godot project.

Inspect and test for strategic degeneracy, unusable placement/upgrade flow, reaction bugs, stuck waves, boss failures, reset/progression bugs, boundary violations, and dishonest metrics. Return pass or revise with concrete evidence.

Act as a strict visual/experience director. Inspect every visual-capture image with image-aware tools and compare against the pinned target, baselines, STYLE.md, visual-direction.json, and design system. Judge observable craft, not prompt compliance. Pass only if the contract clears; otherwise revise with a small prioritized repair brief. Always return findings.scorecard numeric 0-100 for material_depth, focal_hierarchy, combat_legibility, authored_specificity, composition_typography, motion_feedback. Always return findings.evidence with one object per required view containing view, path, and a concrete observation, plus findings.blockingIssues. Never inflate scores or call it fun without human playtest.
